statement: The frozen v1 Windows launch protocol, consisting of Popen of the locked virtual-environment Python followed by assigning only its root PID to a Job Object before releasing a stdin RUN barrier, guarantees containment of every worker interpreter and descendant under every permitted scheduling interleaving.

scope.description: Only the unconditional containment guarantee of build_20260930_exact_eight_parallel_batch.py SHA6b1b4c4f80a24e6851643032689df37a5a9641ee4c465ae04aab3f008ae8ec44 on the observed Windows virtual-environment interpreter launch path. A live harmless pre-assignment scheduling countercontrol refutes universality; historical research-run containment is not adjudicated.

assumptions: Popen may schedule the interpreter launcher before the parent executes AssignProcessToJobObject.
The canary application remains blocked on RUN until after root assignment; a startup record proves its interpreter already exists.
Only exact owned process handles and explicit runtime-child records are inspected.
method: Harmless real three-generation writer tree using the unchanged WindowsJob assign/terminate implementation; controlled pre-assignment scheduling delay, exact IsProcessInJob/WaitForSingleObject queries and heartbeat observations; explicit cleanup of all known owned handles.
